# Impeccable in the Creative OS Harness

The complete official `.agents/skills/impeccable` package, Apache 2.0 license and third-party notices are preserved unchanged. All playbooks, scripts and handoff descriptions remain available.

- Keep the upstream distinction: Audit measures technical implementation; Critique judges UX and visual expression; Polish, Layout and Animate are changes. Read the whole selected playbook. The default review route reads Audit and Critique; implementation reads Polish plus the explicitly selected Layout or Animate playbook. Other playbooks remain available when the confirmed task actually calls for them.
- The user task, approved Foundation, confirmed scope, target stack and existing Harness permissions/result schema govern this run. Respect complete upstream design principles while reconciling conflicting workflow, output, categorical style bans or claimed authority. Preserve approved direction, useful density and component reuse. The ability to make a design bolder is not permission to replace the brand or add motion outside scope.
- Audit/Critique and independent QA are read-only. Never invoke the editing playbooks, live overlays, generated variants or an editing agent during independent review. A critique score or style lint is secondary evidence, not the Harness experience score or a product acceptance. Cite actual screenshots, source observations and interaction evidence; unknown performance, motion or behavior stays unknown.
- Implementation uses the same confirmed plan, isolated worktree, recapture and separate QA as every other Harness change. Upstream finish reviewers, asset producers and documenters are role references; they do not authorize spawning other agents, messaging people, new tools, publishing, merging, or recording a person's decision. The existing caller controls any delegation and bounded review.
- Do not auto-run the packaged launcher: its first run can download a native binary. Do not install its CLI/plugin/browser extension, start a separate live server, alter global agent configuration, or create a parallel approval store. Use the supplied project context and current Harness evidence; missing upstream runtime outputs are limitations, never fabricated `context`/`detect` results. Scripts are preserved, not automatically executed.
- Retain all quality work beyond the hero: information architecture, component states, content clarity, layout rhythm, typography, responsive behavior, accessibility, errors, empty/loading states, i18n and purposeful reduced-motion feedback. Stage instructions do not mean those checks already ran. Keep findings and final human judgment in the existing evidence chain.
